description: This file defines FastAPI endpoints for Google GenAI and Google Interactions API, handling content generation, token counting, interaction management (create, retrieve, delete, cancel), with dependency injection, request processing, and streaming responses.

methods.name: google_generate_content
methods.description: Handles POST requests to generate content from a specified model, adding request metadata, and invoking the LLM router.

methods.name: google_stream_generate_content
methods.description: Handles streaming content generation requests, enforcing streaming, and returning streaming responses if applicable.

methods.name: google_count_tokens
methods.description: Counts tokens for provided contents, translating to internal format, and returning token details.

methods.name: create_interaction
methods.description: Creates a new interaction via Google's Interactions API, processing request data and invoking the LLM router.

methods.name: get_interaction
methods.description: Retrieves an interaction by ID using the LLM router.

methods.name: delete_interaction
methods.description: Deletes an interaction by ID via the LLM router.

methods.name: cancel_interaction
methods.description: Cancels an interaction by ID via the LLM router.
